encoding: series are flat arrays; position i is the hour t0 + i, null where absent
basis: All-island 15-minute EirGrid series aggregated to hourly means (>=3 of 4 quarters required). Demand, wind and solar in MW; carbon intensity in g CO2 per kWh. Source: EirGrid Smart Grid Dashboard. temp_ai is population-weighted island air temperature in degrees C, ERA5 via Open-Meteo, weights as the daily HDD feed. EVERY series is keyed on Irish local clock, not UTC, so temperature and demand describe the same hour year-round.
